total_note: Everything above, for the four of you
intro: All four hotels are booked. Here is everything in between for the four of you, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks it in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All eight transfers
transfers.note: Mykonos airport to Cali, Cali to Mykonos port, Paros port to Parilio, Parilio to Paros port, Santorini port to Andronis Arcadia, Andronis Arcadia to Santorini airport, Athens airport to One&Only Aesthesis, and Aesthesis to Athens airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

boats.title: Mykonos to Paros on a private yacht, with swim stops
boats.note: A Sunseeker Manhattan 60 flybridge with captain and host, cheeses, cold cuts and fresh fruit, soft drinks, beer and wine, towels, snorkel gear and wifi, fuel included. Your luggage comes with you.

flights.title: Santorini to Athens, Aegean A3351
flights.note: Booked on the 6:00am departure (lands 6:45am), Comfort Flex fares for four. The time can be moved to a later flight so the girls are not up before dawn; tell me what suits. A driver meets you in Athens for the Riviera.

optional_title: Other yachts for the Mykonos to Paros day

optional.title: Azimut 55 flybridge
optional.note: Same day, crew and inclusions on a slightly smaller yacht. Replaces the Sunseeker.

optional.title: Aicon 72 hardtop
optional.note: The bigger option: more deck and more shade for the girls. Replaces the Sunseeker.

optional_note: Not in the total above. Pick either instead of the Sunseeker and I will adjust the deposit before you pay.
fine_after_ferry: The Santorini to Athens flight can change date for the fare difference; cancelling it carries airline fees.
fine_boat: The yacht: 30% of the charter confirms it. Cancelling 45 to 30 days before the day costs 50% of the charter, and inside 30 days 100%. If the captain or port authority cancels for weather or a technical problem, it is refunded. Fuel can move with the market; you hear about any change in advance.
